weekly.text: No recruit targets left: every Sunday meal is an army trio

missables.text: Clear every 11/27 quest before the Bertrand fight: this is the last free time of Part I
missables.lose: Every unfinished quest, mentorship unlock and shop trip
detail: Three vegetable deliveries; Flying Steed, Trouble at the Gate, The Artisans of Megaira.
Bringing Peace, Beasts Blocking the Path Home, Brawlers of the Plains.
All three mentorship unlocks (Bertrand's needs Renown 10).

missables.text: Catch every Part II mount by 11/27: Part II has no free time to lure one
missables.lose: The mount, for the rest of Part II
detail: No Black Magonius for Cai yet? Mystery of Headman's Rock takes you to [[place:Headsman's Rock]].
Stolen Star Observations takes you to [[place:Bau-Caller's Cape]]: catch 2 Wild Bau for the Dragoons.
Also a horse each for Cai's Bardinger and Tialla's Troubadour stints, plus the bench riders' mounts.

note.text: Last exam pass: any Advanced exam still open from Ch 10 or 11 (Seteth, Ninae, Ultand)
detail: Fianna → [[class:Troubadour]] now if Bertrand's request unlocked it and she is Lv 35; else Part II Ch 2.
Check every bench unit has its Part II ranks (Army roster).
Spend spare Licenses: Part II gives 5 Beginner, 5 Specialty and 5 Advanced every chapter.

barter.for: Jasmine: armored, so its 5 weight costs her nothing that matters

route.note: Temple Soldier on the staircase. The trip doubles as Cai's Black Magonius catch

sub.note: The Djilu Coin is in Giant's-Print Fort, Ogmios
The trip doubles as the Wild Bau catch

explore.text: Level on Ogmios, Part I's highest dungeons: run [[place:Giant's-Print Fort]] with your support pairs
Skip Can't Stay Home and The Hunter for Gisco's Treasure: both end 10/24, before this free time

tips.text: Split into two groups and keep Cai on protective tiles
Bring a Physic user such as Tialla: it helps a lot
The barrier drops when you hit the switches or when Cai defeats Castor
Pack Part II stock and keep it after the fight
detail: Cai a Concoction, Seteth the Bowbreak Amulet, Noctula a Miranilla Juice and Pure Water.
